title: Forest Walk and Urban Feast Culinary Tour Portland
blurb:
Explore the beautiful Forest Park and the vibrant culinary scene of Portland on this unique 4-hour tour. Journey through 3 miles of scenic trails and urban pathways, stopping at four carefully selected local eateries, bakeries, and food carts to savor the city’s flavors. Discover engaging stories about the history of the park and Portland itself while enjoying a pre-set menu designed to tantalize your taste buds. Ideal for food lovers and history buffs alike, this tour offers a delightful blend of nature and dining.

- 4-hour guided tour with a maximum of 10 guests for an intimate experience
- Features 2 miles of moderate forest walking and 1 mile of city walking
- Includes stops at four hand-picked culinary destinations
- Vegetarian meal options available; please inform of any special requests in advance
